feedback.details: Diagram passes mmdc validation (exit 0) and correctly uses flowchart LR per critic system rules. Non-standard Mermaid node shapes are used: cylinder for User (line 254), database for PostgreSQL (line 256), double-rectangle for Pinecone (line 257). Subgraph boundary (line 270) is present. The sprint contract demands C4Container/C4Boundary syntax but critic rules ban those - this contradiction is noted but cannot be resolved by the document author.

All four required containers present in diagram and narrative. CRITICAL ANTI-PATTERN: Pinecone (Knowledge Base Vector Store) is an external managed service (line 39: 'Pinecone managed vector database') but is placed INSIDE the system subgraph sys (line 273). This violates the C4 rule 'External system inside system subgraph -> High severity.' Pinecone should be outside the boundary like Telegram (line 258, correctly placed outside). Edge labels include protocols (HTTPS, libpq/TCP, REST/HTTPS) which is good.

All mandatory sections present: H1 Title (line 5), H2 Scope (line 7), H2 Architecture Overview (line 10), H3 Component Details (line 13), H2 Traceability (line 46). Passive voice ~7.5%, well under 15% threshold. No subjective adjectives detected. Issues: Line 8 is 460 chars and line 11 is 681 chars - both are single massive unreadable paragraphs. Technical terms not defined on first use: 'libpq' (line 11), 'JWT' (line 202), 'Flyway' (line 230), 'Redis' (lines 209, 241), 'ILIKE' (line 44, only partially defined).

Table (lines 47-110) maps FR6-FR50 and NFR1-NFR17 comprehensively. Three issues: (1) Contract specifies PRD IDs format 'DB-001, KB-002' but document uses raw FR/NFR IDs - this was flagged in Rounds 1-3 and remains unfixed. (2) Deferred section (line 113) references FR51-FR55 which NEVER appear in the traceability table - these IDs are unaccounted for. (3) No formal risk assessment justification for deferred items - contract mandates 'a formal Deferred subsection with risk assessment justification.' Current section has no risk matrix, impact assessment, or mitigation timeline. FR7 (store plant data in markdown) being Deferred undermines the sprint purpose.

All three required elements present with copy-pasteable examples. Database connection string (lines 117-121) includes format, example, ENV variable, pool config. KB API schemas (lines 123-192) provide full JSON request/response for upsert and query with headers, status codes, errors. Authentication (lines 194-204) covers PostgreSQL, Pinecone, and API Gateway auth. Minor gap: no sslmode=require in format string (line 118), though SSL mentioned in auth section (line 197).

Multiple persistent violations: (1) TRAILING WHITESPACE: 18 lines with trailing whitespace (lines 126, 142, 154, 168, 170, 195, 198, 201, 210, 214, 221, 225, 232, 236, 243, 247, 259, 268) - pattern is spaces after bold list markers. (2) NO TRAILING NEWLINE: File ends with closing triple-backtick on line 275 without final newline (verified via xxd). MD047 violation. (3) EXTREME LINE LENGTHS: Line 11 is 681 chars, line 8 is 460 chars, 20+ lines exceed 120 chars. Trailing whitespace is a recurring chronic problem across all Sprint 5 rounds.

All four required failure modes documented comprehensively (lines 206-249): (1) DB Connection Pool Exhaustion - pool sizes, timeout, retry, fallback, metrics with thresholds. (2) KB Vector Index Corruption - health checks, snapshots, ILIKE fallback, drift monitoring. (3) Schema Migration Rollback - Flyway, blue-green, automatic rollback. (4) High Latency Fallback - L1/L2 cache, stale-while-revalidate, thundering herd detection. Each scenario includes mitigation, fallback path, and specific monitoring metrics. No gaps detected.

overall_summary: Round 4 shows marginal improvement (7.6 average) but two critical issues remain unresolved. The C4 Container Completeness is hampered by a High-severity antipattern: Pinecone (an external managed service) is placed inside the system subgraph boundary (line 273), violating C4 ownership model rules. The Markdown Formatting Standards score of 5.0 is the weakest area — 18 trailing whitespace violations, no trailing newline, and catastrophic line lengths (681 chars max) persist despite being flagged in every Sprint 5 round. The PRD Traceability Matrix uses FR/NFR IDs instead of the contract-mandated DB-001/KB-002 format, and the Deferred section lacks formal risk assessment. Interface Contract Documentation (9.5) and Adversarial Edge Case Coverage (9.5) remain the strongest areas with no meaningful gaps. The document will not pass the contract until the Pinecone placement is corrected, trailing whitespace is eliminated, and the traceability matrix format aligns with the sprint contract.
